news.headline: Master Meter Announces Honua Waterworks as New Authorized Distributor for Hawaii

paragraphs: Master Meter sells ultrasonic water measurement and AMI, offered as options that can be taken up together. The Allegro line is described as a combination of AMI technologies aimed at the challenges of each utility. The software is described in terms of water management, customer service, and water sustainability challenges.

Sonata is presented as a residential meter built without moving parts. Octave is the ultrasonic meter the site ties to grade 316 stainless steel for corrosion resistance and durability. Compatibility runs in both directions between the meters and the AMI, as stated on the site. A starter kit bundles an Allegro Cellular AMI product with Harmony-Encore MDM software and training.

quote.text: Master Meter’s Allegro combines several AMI technologies to offer unique benefits for the unique challenges of each utility.
